senses.gloss: हुम् (I) ind. A particle expressive of- (1) remembrance, e.g. हुं ज्ञातमेतत्, or रामो नाम बभूव हुं तदबला सीतेति हुम्; (2) interrogation; (3) assent; (4) anger; (5) reproach.
हुम् (II) ind. A mystical syllable occurring frequently in spells and incantations, e.g. ॐ कवचाय हुम्.(हुंकृ ‘to roar, to grunt.’ With अनु-, to roar in return, अनुहुंकुरुते घनध्वनिं Sis.xvi.25.)
